title: Princess Kate makes debut Halloween post with adorable Prince Louis photo

 Anthony Robledo, USA TODAY Updated Sat, 31 October 2026 at 5:53 pm UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Princess Kate and Prince William have finally decided to get into the spooky season spirit.
 The Princess and Prince of Wales, both 44, made their first-ever Halloween-themed post on Saturday, Oct. 31, sharing a photo of their son, Prince Louis . The photo, taken by Kate, shows Louis, now 8, at age 1, smiling over a pumpkin on the ground.
 "Happy Halloween! 🎃," the royal couple captioned the adorable Instagram post on Halloween, Oct. 31.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Though the couple has not posted about Halloween before, they have previously celebrated the haunting holiday in years past with Louis and their other kids, Prince George , 13, and daughter Princess Charlotte , 11.
 Halloween 2026: Paris Hilton, Heidi Klum, more unveil wild costumes 
 In 2022, Kate and the kids were spotted collecting candy on Halloween in a photo taken by a London resident, Jay Rutland, according to Hello! magazine .
 "For anyone doubting how down to earth William and Kate are," Rutland wrote. "This is Kate with their kids knocking on our door in London trick-or-treating at Halloween."
 Prince William and Prince Kate arrive for a State Banquet at Windsor Castle on Oct. 20, 2026. In 2019, local Kathy Whittaker said she saw the princess, then Kate Middleton, at a local supermarket in Norfolk with George and Charlotte as they picked costumes for Halloween, People magazine reported.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Halloween 2026: See 'Today' show, Kelly and Mark and more TV hosts' costumes 
 Louis, who turned 8 in April, is the fourth in line to the British throne, preceded by Charlotte, George and their father William.
 Spooky season is in full swing, and Hollywood's biggest names are getting into the Halloween and Día de Muertos spirit with elaborate costumes, star-studded parties and plenty of tricks and treats.
So far, Brittany Broski hosted a Halloween bash alongside Smirnoff Ice, featuring reality TV personalities and a DJ set by "RuPaul's Drag Race" winner Monét X Change. Meanwhile, Rita Moreno was among the honorees at the sixth annual Día de Muertos Gala, held Oct. 27 at the Universal Studios Backlot.

 The account also posted a video montage of the young prince on the beach, playing cricket and jumping into the sea, likely during a trip to Holkham Beach in Norfolk, England, near their Anmer Hall home and a spot frequented by the royal family.
 "Thank you for all the birthday wishes for Prince Louis. 8 is great!" the British royals captioned the reel.
